verdict.rationale: Braintrust documents its own way to get trace data out: logs can be downloaded as CSV or JSON, or pulled locally with `bt sync pull`. This is a genuine first-party export, but nothing shows bulk export to blob storage or a data warehouse, so the user must move the files to that destination themselves. Self-hosting keeps data in your own cloud account, which is a residency feature rather than an export pipeline, so it earns no credit. missing for 10: native export or sync to blob storage (S3/GCS/Azure), data-warehouse connectors (Snowflake/BigQuery/etc.), documented bulk dataset export, scheduled or recurring exports, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can bulk-export traces and datasets to blob storage or my data warehouse
